---
pagetitle: "CONSORT-AI checklist"
page-layout: full
toc: false
resources:
  - /assets/logos/spirit-consort-logo.png
  - /assets/logos/equator_logo.png
  - docx.min.js
---

```{=html}
<style>
  #tp-wrap { --accent:#2a5aa7; --head:#bfbfbf; --sect:#b4c6e7; --box:#eef3fb; --boxline:#9fb6dc; --line:#000; --ai:#f2f2f2;
    font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; color:#111; max-width:1200px; margin:0 auto; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-top { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:.8rem; }
  #tp-wrap #tp-logo { width:min(220px,50%); height:auto; display:block; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-right { text-align:right; }
  /* Equator logo: hidden on screen, shown only in the saved PDF (print) */
  #tp-wrap .tp-eq { display:none; width:150px; height:auto; margin-left:auto; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-title { font-size:19px; font-weight:bold; line-height:1.3; margin:0 0 .2rem; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta { font:14px Arial,sans-serif; margin:.4rem 0 .8rem; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta label { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; width:100%; font-weight:bold; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta input { flex:0 1 50%; min-width:0; font:14px Arial,sans-serif; font-weight:normal; padding:.35rem .5rem;
    border:1.5px solid var(--boxline); background:var(--box); border-radius:3px; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta input:focus { outline:2px solid var(--accent); background:#fff; }
  #tp-wrap table { border-collapse:collapse; width:100%; font-size:13px; line-height:1.35; }
  #tp-wrap th, #tp-wrap td { border:1px solid var(--line); padding:3px 6px; vertical-align:top; text-align:left; }
  #tp-wrap thead th { background:var(--head); font-weight:bold; vertical-align:middle; }
  #tp-wrap tr.sec td { background:var(--sect); font-weight:bold; padding:2px 6px; }
  #tp-wrap tr.lab td { padding:2px 6px; }
  #tp-wrap td.topic { width:12%; } #tp-wrap td.topic.ind { padding-left:16px; }
  #tp-wrap td.item { width:5%; text-align:center; }
  #tp-wrap td.base { width:25%; }
  #tp-wrap td.ai { width:39%; }
  #tp-wrap td.ai.empty { background:var(--ai); }
  #tp-wrap td.ai b { display:block; }
  #tp-wrap th.pgh, #tp-wrap td.pg { width:11%; }
  #tp-wrap td.pg { padding:3px; vertical-align:middle; }
  #tp-wrap td.pg input { width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; border:1.5px solid var(--boxline); border-radius:3px; background:var(--box);
    text-align:center; font:14px Arial,sans-serif; padding:6px 2px; }
  #tp-wrap td.pg input:hover { border-color:var(--accent); }
  #tp-wrap td.pg input:focus { outline:2px solid var(--accent); background:#fff; }
  #tp-wrap input::placeholder { color:#6a7fa3; font-size:12px; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-hint { display:block; font-weight:normal; font-size:11px; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-foot, #tp-wrap .tp-cite { font-size:12.5px; margin:.6rem 0 0; }
  .tp-actions { display:flex; gap:.6rem; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:1rem 0 1.4rem; }
  .tp-actions button { font:600 15px Arial,sans-serif; padding:.55rem 1.1rem; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer;
    border:2px solid #2a5aa7; background:#2a5aa7; color:#fff; }
  .tp-actions button.alt { background:#fff; color:#2a5aa7; }
  .tp-actions button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #f3b800; outline-offset:2px; }
  .tp-note { font:14px Arial,sans-serif; color:#444; margin:0; flex-basis:100%; }

  @media print {
    @page { size:A4 landscape; margin:10mm; }
    body * { visibility:hidden; }
    #tp-wrap, #tp-wrap * { visibility:visible; }
    #tp-wrap { position:absolute; left:0; top:0; width:100%; max-width:none; }
    .tp-actions { display:none !important; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-eq { display:block; }
    #tp-wrap table { font-size:10px; }
    #tp-wrap tr { break-inside:avoid; }
    #tp-wrap thead { display:table-header-group; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-title { font-size:15px; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-foot, #tp-wrap .tp-cite { font-size:9px; }
    #tp-wrap td.pg input { background:none; border:0; }
    #tp-wrap input::placeholder { color:transparent; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-hint { display:none; }
    #tp-wrap, #tp-wrap th, #tp-wrap tr.sec td, #tp-wrap td.ai.empty { -webkit-print-color-adjust:exact; print-color-adjust:exact; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-meta input { border:0; padding:0; background:none; flex:1 1 auto; }
  }
</style>

<div id="tp-wrap">
  <div class="tp-top">
    <img src="/assets/logos/spirit-consort-logo.png" alt="SPIRIT CONSORT" id="tp-logo">
    <div class="tp-right"><img src="/assets/logos/equator_logo.png" alt="EQUATOR Network" class="tp-eq"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="tp-title">CONSORT-AI checklist of information to include when reporting a randomised trial involving an artificial intelligence intervention<sup>*</sup></div>
  <div class="tp-actions">
    <button type="button" id="tp-pdf">Save as PDF</button>
    <button type="button" id="tp-doc" class="alt">Save as Word</button>
    <button type="button" id="tp-reset" class="alt">Clear all</button>
    <p class="tp-note">Type the page number(s) where each item is reported in the boxes in the right-hand column, then save your copy as a PDF or Word (.docx) file.
    Where an item has several AI sub-items, enter the page number(s) for each row.
    “Save as PDF” opens your browser’s print dialog: choose <em>Save as PDF</em> as the destination (landscape A4 is set automatically).
    Your entries stay in this browser until you clear them.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="tp-meta"><label>Manuscript title: <input type="text" id="tp-title" data-key="title" placeholder="Type your manuscript title here"></label></div>
  <table id="tp-table">
    <thead><tr>
      <th>Section / Topic</th><th class="c">Item</th><th>CONSORT 2010 item</th><th>CONSORT-AI item</th>
      <th class="pgh">Reported on page no.<sup>†</sup><span class="tp-hint">type page no. in the boxes below</span></th>
    </tr></thead>
    <tbody></tbody>
  </table>
  <div id="tp-foot"></div>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  // Section bars are plain strings; ["L", text] = label row;
  // otherwise [topic, indented?, [[item no, base-guideline text, ai], ...]]
  // where ai = null or a list of [label, text] for the AI-specific items of that row group.
  const ROWS = ["Title and abstract", ["Title and abstract", false, [["1a", "Identification as a randomised trial in the title", [["CONSORT-AI 1a,b (i) Elaboration", "Indicate that the intervention involves artificial intelligence/machine learning in the title and/or abstract and specify the type of model."]]], ["1b", "Structured summary of trial design, methods, results, and conclusions (for specific guidance see CONSORT for abstracts)", [["CONSORT-AI 1a,b (ii) Elaboration", "State the intended use of the AI intervention within the trial in the title and/or abstract."]]]]], "Introduction", ["Background and objectives", false, [["2a", "Scientific background and explanation of rationale", [["CONSORT-AI 2a (i) Extension", "Explain the intended use of the AI intervention in the context of the clinical pathway, including its purpose and its intended users (e.g. healthcare professionals, patients, public)."]]], ["2b", "Specific objectives or hypotheses", null]]], "Methods", ["Trial design", false, [["3a", "Description of trial design (such as parallel, factorial) including allocation ratio", null], ["3b", "Important changes to methods after trial commencement (such as eligibility criteria), with reasons", null]]], ["Participants", false, [["4a", "Eligibility criteria for participants", [["CONSORT-AI 4a (i) Elaboration", "State the inclusion and exclusion criteria at the level of participants."], ["CONSORT-AI 4a (ii) Extension", "State the inclusion and exclusion criteria at the level of the input data."]]], ["4b", "Settings and locations where the data were collected", [["CONSORT-AI 4b Extension", "Describe how the AI intervention was integrated into the trial setting, including any onsite or offsite requirements."]]]]], ["Interventions", false, [["5", "The interventions for each group with sufficient details to allow replication, including how and when they were actually administered", [["CONSORT-AI 5 (i) Extension", "State which version of the AI algorithm was used."], ["CONSORT-AI 5 (ii) Extension", "Describe how the input data were acquired and selected for the AI intervention."], ["CONSORT-AI 5 (iii) Extension", "Describe how poor quality or unavailable input data were assessed and handled."], ["CONSORT-AI 5 (iv) Extension", "Specify whether there was human-AI interaction in the handling of the input data, and what level of expertise was required of users."], ["CONSORT-AI 5 (v) Extension", "Specify the output of the AI intervention."], ["CONSORT-AI 5 (vi) Extension", "Explain how the AI intervention’s outputs contributed to decision-making or other elements of clinical practice."]]]]], ["Outcomes", false, [["6a", "Completely defined pre-specified primary and secondary outcome measures, including how and when they were assessed", null], ["6b", "Any changes to trial outcomes after the trial commenced, with reasons", null]]], ["Sample size", false, [["7a", "How sample size was determined", null], ["7b", "When applicable, explanation of any interim analyses and stopping guidelines", null]]], ["L", "Randomisation:"], ["Sequence generation", true, [["8a", "Method used to generate the random allocation sequence", null], ["8b", "Type of randomisation; details of any restriction (such as blocking and block size)", null]]], ["Allocation concealment mechanism", true, [["9", "Mechanism used to implement the random allocation sequence (such as sequentially numbered containers), describing any steps taken to conceal the sequence until interventions were assigned", null]]], ["Implementation", true, [["10", "Who generated the random allocation sequence, who enrolled participants, and who assigned participants to interventions", null]]], ["Blinding", false, [["11a", "If done, who was blinded after assignment to interventions (for example, participants, care providers, those assessing outcomes) and how", null], ["11b", "If relevant, description of the similarity of interventions", null]]], ["Statistical methods", false, [["12a", "Statistical methods used to compare groups for primary and secondary outcomes", null], ["12b", "Methods for additional analyses, such as subgroup analyses and adjusted analyses", null]]], "Results", ["Participant flow (a diagram is strongly recommended)", false, [["13a", "For each group, the numbers of participants who were randomly assigned, received intended treatment, and were analysed for the primary outcome", null], ["13b", "For each group, losses and exclusions after randomisation, together with reasons", null]]], ["Recruitment", false, [["14a", "Dates defining the periods of recruitment and follow-up", null], ["14b", "Why the trial ended or was stopped", null]]], ["Baseline data", false, [["15", "A table showing baseline demographic and clinical characteristics for each group", null]]], ["Numbers analysed", false, [["16", "For each group, number of participants (denominator) included in each analysis and whether the analysis was by original assigned groups", null]]], ["Outcomes and estimation", false, [["17a", "For each primary and secondary outcome, results for each group, and the estimated effect size and its precision (such as 95% confidence interval)", null], ["17b", "For binary outcomes, presentation of both absolute and relative effect sizes is recommended", null]]], ["Ancillary analyses", false, [["18", "Results of any other analyses performed, including subgroup analyses and adjusted analyses, distinguishing pre-specified from exploratory", null]]], ["Harms", false, [["19", "All important harms or unintended effects in each group (for specific guidance see CONSORT for harms)", [["CONSORT-AI 19 Extension", "Describe results of any analysis of performance errors and how errors were identified, where applicable. If no such analysis was planned or done, justify why not."]]]]], "Discussion", ["Limitations", false, [["20", "Trial limitations, addressing sources of potential bias, imprecision, and, if relevant, multiplicity of analyses", null]]], ["Generalisability", false, [["21", "Generalisability (external validity, applicability) of the trial findings", null]]], ["Interpretation", false, [["22", "Interpretation consistent with results, balancing benefits and harms, and considering other relevant evidence", null]]], "Other information", ["Registration", false, [["23", "Registration number and name of trial registry", null]]], ["Protocol", false, [["24", "Where the full trial protocol can be accessed, if available", null]]], ["Funding", false, [["25", "Sources of funding and other support (such as supply of drugs), role of funders", [["CONSORT-AI 25 Extension", "State whether and how the AI intervention and/or its code can be accessed, including any restrictions to access or re-use."]]]]]];
  const TITLE = "CONSORT-AI checklist of information to include when reporting a randomised trial involving an artificial intelligence intervention";
  const FOOT = ["*We strongly recommend reading this statement in conjunction with the CONSORT 2010 Explanation and Elaboration for important clarifications on all the items.", "†Indicates page numbers to be completed by authors during protocol development.", "From Liu et al, BMJ 2020; 370: m3164. doi: [[10.1136/bmj.m3164|https://doi.org/10.1136/bmj.m3164]]"];

  const STORE = "consort-ai-checklist-v1";
  const slug = s => s.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]+/g, "");
  const tbody = document.querySelector("#tp-table tbody");
  tbody.innerHTML = ROWS.map(r => {
    if (typeof r === "string") return `<tr class="sec"><td colspan="5">${r}</td></tr>`;
    if (r[0] === "L") return `<tr class="lab"><td colspan="5">${r[1]}</td></tr>`;
    const [topic, ind, items] = r;
    const total = items.reduce((s, it) => s + Math.max(1, (it[2] || []).length), 0);
    let first = true, out = "";
    items.forEach(([code, text, ai]) => {
      const list = ai && ai.length ? ai : [null];
      list.forEach((a, j) => {
        const key = a ? slug(a[0]) : code, name = a ? a[0] : "item " + code;
        out += `<tr>` + (first ? `<td class="topic${ind ? " ind" : ""}" rowspan="${total}">${topic}</td>` : "") +
          (j ? "" : `<td class="item" rowspan="${list.length}">${code}</td><td class="base" rowspan="${list.length}">${text}</td>`) +
          (a ? `<td class="ai"><b>${a[0]}</b>${a[1]}</td>` : `<td class="ai empty"></td>`) +
          `<td class="pg"><input type="text" data-key="p${key}" placeholder="page no." aria-label="Page, ${name}"></td></tr>`;
        first = false;
      });
    });
    return out;
  }).join("");

  // Footnotes (links are written as [[text|url]])
  const linkify = t => t.replace(/\[\[(.*?)\|(.*?)\]\]/g, (_, text, url) => `<a ${"href"}="${url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${text}</a>`)
    .replace(/^\*/, "<sup>*</sup>").replace(/^†/, "<sup>†</sup>");
  document.getElementById("tp-foot").innerHTML = FOOT.map((t, i) => `<p class="${t.startsWith("Citation") || t.startsWith("From") ? "tp-cite" : "tp-foot"}">${linkify(t)}</p>`).join("");

  const fields = () => [...document.querySelectorAll("#tp-wrap input")];
  const load = () => { try { const d = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORE) || "{}");
    fields().forEach(i => { if (d[i.dataset.key]) i.value = d[i.dataset.key]; }); } catch (e) {} };
  const save = () => { try { const d = {}; fields().forEach(i => { if (i.value) d[i.dataset.key] = i.value; });
    localStorage.setItem(STORE, JSON.stringify(d)); } catch (e) {} };
  load();
  document.getElementById("tp-wrap").addEventListener("input", save);

  // Save as PDF via the browser print dialog (print CSS shows only the checklist + EQUATOR logo)
  document.getElementById("tp-pdf").onclick = () => {
    const old = document.title;
    document.title = "CONSORT-AI checklist";
    window.print();
    document.title = old;
  };

  document.getElementById("tp-reset").onclick = () => {
    if (confirm("Clear all page numbers and the manuscript title?")) { fields().forEach(i => i.value = ""); save(); }
  };

  // ---- Word (.docx) export -------------------------------------------------
  // <BUILD>
  function buildDocx(D, ROWS, vals, logo, title, foot, eqLogo) {
    // Landscape A4: usable width = 16838 - 2*720 = 15398 twips
    const F = "Arial", SZ = 16, W = [1900, 650, 3900, 6998, 1950], TOTAL = W.reduce((a, b) => a + b);
    const ln = { style: D.BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 6, color: "000000" };
    const run = (text, o = {}) => new D.TextRun({ text, font: F, size: o.size || SZ, bold: o.bold, superScript: o.sup });
    const runs = (text, o = {}) => {
      const out = [], re = /\[\[(.*?)\|(.*?)\]\]/g; let last = 0, m;
      while ((m = re.exec(text))) {
        if (m.index > last) out.push(run(text.slice(last, m.index), o));
        out.push(new D.ExternalHyperlink({ link: m[2], children: [new D.TextRun({ text: m[1], font: F, size: o.size || SZ, color: "0563C1", underline: {} })] }));
        last = re.lastIndex;
      }
      if (last < text.length) out.push(run(text.slice(last), o));
      return out;
    };
    const cell = (i, children, o = {}) => new D.TableCell({
      width: { size: o.span ? TOTAL : W[i], type: D.WidthType.DXA }, columnSpan: o.span ? 5 : undefined, rowSpan: o.rowSpan,
      verticalAlign: o.mid ? D.VerticalAlign.CENTER : D.VerticalAlign.TOP,
      shading: o.fill ? { type: D.ShadingType.CLEAR, fill: o.fill, color: "auto" } : undefined,
      margins: { top: 40, bottom: 40, left: o.indent || 90, right: 90 }, borders: { top: ln, bottom: ln, left: ln, right: ln },
      children: [new D.Paragraph({ keepNext: o.keepNext, alignment: o.center ? D.AlignmentType.CENTER : D.AlignmentType.LEFT, children })]
    });
    const tcell = (i, text, o = {}) => cell(i, runs(text, o), o);
    const hd = { fill: "BFBFBF", bold: true, mid: true };
    const head = new D.TableRow({ tableHeader: true, cantSplit: true, children: [
      tcell(0, "Section / Topic", hd), tcell(1, "Item", { ...hd, center: true }),
      tcell(2, "CONSORT 2010 item", hd), tcell(3, "CONSORT-AI item", hd), tcell(4, "Reported on page no.†", hd)] });
    const slugF = s => s.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]+/g, "");
    const body = ROWS.flatMap(r => {
      if (typeof r === "string") return [new D.TableRow({ cantSplit: true, children: [tcell(0, r, { span: true, fill: "B4C6E7", bold: true, keepNext: true })] })];
      if (r[0] === "L") return [new D.TableRow({ cantSplit: true, children: [tcell(0, r[1], { span: true, keepNext: true })] })];
      const [topic, ind, items] = r;
      const total = items.reduce((s, it) => s + Math.max(1, (it[2] || []).length), 0);
      let first = true;
      return items.flatMap(([code, text, ai]) => {
        const list = ai && ai.length ? ai : [null];
        return list.map((a, j) => {
          const cells = [];
          if (first) cells.push(tcell(0, topic, { rowSpan: total, indent: ind ? 260 : 90 }));
          if (!j) {
            cells.push(tcell(1, code, { center: true, rowSpan: list.length }));
            cells.push(tcell(2, text, { rowSpan: list.length }));
          }
          cells.push(a
            ? cell(3, [run(a[0], { bold: true }), new D.TextRun({ break: 1 }), ...runs(a[1])])
            : tcell(3, "", { fill: "F2F2F2" }));
          cells.push(tcell(4, vals["p" + (a ? slugF(a[0]) : code)] || "", { center: true, mid: true }));
          first = false;
          return new D.TableRow({ cantSplit: true, children: cells });
        });
      });
    });
    const para = (children, o = {}) => new D.Paragraph({ spacing: { after: 80 }, ...o, children });
    const footer = new D.Footer({ children: [new D.Paragraph({ alignment: D.AlignmentType.CENTER,
      children: [new D.TextRun({ children: ["Page ", D.PageNumber.CURRENT, " of ", D.PageNumber.TOTAL_PAGES], font: F, size: 18 })] })] });
    const top = [];
    const none = { style: D.BorderStyle.NONE, size: 0, color: "FFFFFF" };
    const noBorders = { top: none, bottom: none, left: none, right: none };
    const HW = [9000, 6398];
    const hcell = (i, children) => new D.TableCell({
      width: { size: HW[i], type: D.WidthType.DXA }, borders: noBorders,
      verticalAlign: D.VerticalAlign.CENTER, margins: { top: 0, bottom: 0, left: 0, right: 0 }, children });
    const left = logo ? [para([new D.ImageRun({ data: logo, type: "png", transformation: { width: 180, height: 64 } })], { spacing: { after: 0 } })] : [para([], { spacing: { after: 0 } })];
    const right = eqLogo
      ? [para([new D.ImageRun({ data: eqLogo, type: "png", transformation: { width: 140, height: Math.round(140 * 90 / 310) } })], { alignment: D.AlignmentType.RIGHT, spacing: { after: 0 } })]
      : [para([], { spacing: { after: 0 } })];
    top.push(new D.Table({ width: { size: HW[0] + HW[1], type: D.WidthType.DXA }, columnWidths: HW, borders: { ...noBorders, insideHorizontal: none, insideVertical: none },
      rows: [new D.TableRow({ children: [hcell(0, left), hcell(1, right)] })] }));
    top.push(para([], { spacing: { after: 60 } }));
    top.push(para([run(title, { bold: true, size: 24 }), run("*", { bold: true, size: 24, sup: true })], { spacing: { after: 100 } }));
    top.push(para([run("Manuscript title: ", { bold: true, size: 20 }), run(vals.title || "", { size: 20 })], { spacing: { after: 120 } }));
    return new D.Document({
      title: "CONSORT-AI checklist", creator: "CONSORT-AI checklist",
      sections: [{
        footers: { default: footer },
        properties: { page: { size: { width: 11906, height: 16838, orientation: D.PageOrientation.LANDSCAPE }, margin: { top: 720, bottom: 800, left: 720, right: 720 } } },
        children: [...top, new D.Table({ width: { size: TOTAL, type: D.WidthType.DXA }, columnWidths: W, rows: [head, ...body] }),
          ...foot.map((t, i) => para(runs(t, { size: 16 }), { spacing: { before: i ? 60 : 140 } }))]
      }]
    });
  }
  // </BUILD>

  const loadDocx = () => window.docx ? Promise.resolve() : new Promise((res, rej) => {
    const el = document.createElement("script");
    el.src = new URL("docx.min.js", document.baseURI).href;
    el.onload = res; el.onerror = () => rej(new Error("Could not load docx.min.js"));
    document.head.appendChild(el);
  });

  document.getElementById("tp-doc").onclick = async () => {
    const btn = document.getElementById("tp-doc"), label = btn.textContent;
    btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = "Preparing…";
    try {
      await loadDocx();
      let logo = null;
      try { logo = new Uint8Array(await (await fetch(new URL("/assets/logos/spirit-consort-logo.png", document.baseURI))).arrayBuffer()); } catch (e) {}
      let eqLogo = null;
      try { eqLogo = new Uint8Array(await (await fetch(new URL("/assets/logos/equator_logo.png", document.baseURI))).arrayBuffer()); } catch (e) {}
      const vals = {}; fields().forEach(i => vals[i.dataset.key] = i.value);
      const blob = await window.docx.Packer.toBlob(buildDocx(window.docx, ROWS, vals, logo, TITLE, FOOT, eqLogo));
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([blob], { type: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document" }));
      a.download = "CONSORT-AI-checklist.docx";
      document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 2000);
    } catch (e) {
      alert("Sorry, the Word file could not be created. " + e.message);
    } finally { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = label; }
  };
})();
</script>
```
